title: Grateful Dead Live at Fillmore East on 1971-04-26
source: MSR  7 inch (7.5 ips) Revox A 77 >Alesis Masterlink>CD-R

ai_review.summary: An excellent‑sounding soundboard capture of a legendary ’71 show with Duane Allman’s guest spot on Sugar Magnolia and multiple standout Pigpen moments.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the astonishing performance – highlighting Big Boss Man, Loser, Dark Star, Casey Jones, and the Duane Allman‑enhanced Sugar Magnolia – and praise the stereo‑phonic hi‑fi soundboard mix as “excellent.” A few notes mention a slowdown artifact in the Archive’s mastering and minor audio anomalies on Wharf Rat, giving the technical picture a mixed edge.

ai_rating.rationale: The musical performance is consistently praised as high‑energy and historic (70% weight), while recording quality is mostly described as excellent but with some complaints about speed alteration and occasional glitches (30% weight).

recording_quality.technical_notes: Stereo‑phonic hi‑fi mix praised as crisp and clean; a handful of reviewers note a slowdown artifact from the Archive’s remaster and a few audio anomalies on Wharf Rat.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: The show opens with a full New Riders of the Purple Sage set, then launches into an electrifying Dead second half that blends bluesy covers, soaring jams and multiple Pigpen showcases.

band_member_comments.Keys: Pigpen’s harmonica/vocals are highlighted as exceptional on several tracks (e.g., It Hurts Me Too, classic Pigpen moments).
